title: Zeus Juice Mortals - Monkberry 100ml shortfill E-Liquid
description: Zeus Juice has resurrected Monkberry, a classic e-liquid that brings the nostalgic taste of fresh strawberries and smooth, creamy banana, laced with lip-smacking sweetshop candy notes that together make this favourite e-liquid worthy of immortality. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vape kits and sub-ohm tanks .
